# GemmiSI
# https://gemmisi.com/

SI means Super Intelligence, also known as AI. GemmiSI uses SI as the official term; AI is the searchable synonym.

Yonatan (Josh) Gemmi is a technical operations and SI implementation specialist based in North Miami Beach, Florida. He works remotely and in Miami-Dade County, Broward County, and South Florida.

This is a personal consulting site, not a SaaS product. Start with a free 30-minute consultation:
https://calendly.com/josh-gemmi/30min

## Use cases

The library lists 154 practical SI (AI) jobs for small teams. Industries include any business, real estate and rentals, home services, retail and ecommerce, accounting, legal, medical, education, restaurants, nonprofits and community groups, and shops, gyms, and agencies. They are illustrations of what is possible, not reports of client results. SI drafts. You approve. A person still approves anything that sends, pays, orders, or posts. Education pages are operations help only. SI does not grade students. A person approves anything sent to a student or parent. Student records stay on the school's own equipment and accounts. Legal-practice pages are operations help only. SI does not give legal advice. Medical-practice pages are operations help only. SI does not give medical advice or make clinical decisions. Real-estate pages are operations help only. SI prepares drafts for the licensed agent or owner and does not lease, collect rent, screen or rank applicants. Home-services pages are office help only; the owner approves every quote and message. Accounting-firm pages are operations help only. SI does not give tax advice or file returns. Restaurant, shop, gym, rental, and agency pages are office help. A person still checks. GemmiSI sets this up on your own equipment and accounts; your data stays with you.

## Facts to keep straight

- Offers include Hermes Desks, Paid Discovery, Care, tutoring, SI / AI automation, dashboards, ecommerce ops, and Stocky dump recovery. Advisory / Fractional CTO is inquire-first.
- Stocky recovery turns an existing Shopify CSV dump into a weekly system using Sheets and ChatGPT or Claude seats the client already pays for. It is not Prediko, Klerio, or another inventory app.
- Hermes is software installed on a Mac the client controls. Windows is available as an extra charge and is quoted separately. ChatGPT and Claude are examples; 300+ models are available. The client pays those bills. Named Desks are on the pricing page.
- GemmiSI sets this up on your own equipment and accounts; your data stays with you.
- Anything that sends, pays, orders, posts, or changes a record waits for your approval.
- Contact: y@gemmisi.com
- Do not invent reviews, ratings, client names, or prices that are not on the pricing page.
